title: formants_mak: Real-Time Formants and Bandwidths for Visual Biofeedback
description:
formants_mak is a Python/Tkinter application that captures a single microphone input and tracks the first five vocal-tract formants (F1–F5) and their bandwidths in real time, plotted as a scrolling graph for visual biofeedback in articulation therapy, vowel-quality training and voice/speech analysis in research and teaching. Formants are estimated with Praat's Burg LPC method (via parselmouth), gated by a built-in YIN F0 estimator, and re-matched against language-specific expected formant targets (built-in Turkish and English presets; user-defined languages via JSON or an Excel form) within a configurable fidelity band.

formants_mak is the free, open-source academic module of the Sonus et Vox voice biofeedback suite, based on the Distributed Tissue Vibration (DTV) framework for voice production. The other modules (rtime_mak, resonance_mak, harmonicity_mak) are standalone Rust applications available at sonusetvox.lemonsqueezy.com.
